primary.title: South Korea Says Market Measures Will Ease Investor Jitters
primary.summary: South Korea’s finance minister said the government’s latest market-stabilization measures should help restore investor confidence, even as the benchmark Kospi slumped another 5% on Monday following last week’s selloff.
